user.title: Connect to the SVS Bridge
user.description: Enter the bridge's address and the API token shown in its web UI, under Home Assistant.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address, e.g. svs-bridge.local or 192.168.1.57.
data_description.token: Copy it from the bridge's web UI (Home Assistant section).

discovery_confirm.title: SVS Bridge found
discovery_confirm.description: Found {name} at {host}. Paste its API token to finish setup (it is shown in the bridge's web UI, under Home Assistant).

reauth_confirm.title: Update the API token
reauth_confirm.description: The bridge rejected the stored token. Paste the current one from its web UI.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the bridge. Check that it is on and the host is correct.
error.invalid_auth: The bridge rejected that API token.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
